BiblicalUsage: Threshing time is the season of harvest, when the grain is separated from the chaff and the labour of the year is gathered in. The law promises threshing that will reach to the vintage, and the vintage to the sowing time, if the people keep the covenant.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe threshing time is the picture of God's harvest: the season when what was sown is finally separated and gathered.
